name: mgamadeus/ddd-clouddrive
description: Cloud drive for mgamadeus/ddd: spaces with host-owned rights, versioned files in object storage, search, processing in a sandbox, and an optional agent mount for ddd-agents

suggest.mgamadeus/ddd-agents: ^0.1.26 — mounts drive spaces into the agent workspace, an own drive per agent space, the drive tools and widgets (^0.1.29: a scratch drive per eval case)
suggest.mgamadeus/ddd-agent-browser: ^0.2.0 — with ddd-agents: files that leave the agent's browser land in the own drive (CloudDriveBrowserFileSinkService)
suggest.async-aws/s3: The object store of the file bytes (any S3-compatible service)
